v4.6.78 — One-click publish + no duplicate bots + market cleared

✨ PUBLISHING IS NOW ZERO-TYPING
• When you publish a bot, every field — name, description, AI used, brokers, universe, tags — is filled in automatically from the bot’s own info (written by the AI when it was created). You just review one summary and hit Publish.

🛒 BOT MARKET
• The market has been cleared (it was full of duplicate copies of the same bot).
• Duplicates are now blocked: publishing a near-identical copy of ANY bot — including your own — is refused (edit the existing bot instead). Copying someone else’s bot stays blocked too. The hourly moderation bot keeps flagging copyright/metadata issues.

🎨 STYLE
• Flattened the last decorative gradients (Make Bot credits chip, website background) so the sober, minimalist look is consistent everywhere.

Update via the in-app banner.
